authorisation: owner 2026-10-27: 'bu açık, uyumsuzluk ve hataları düzelt ve test et' after the read-only G4e root-cause analysis

root_cause.historical_G4e_FAIL: reproduced bit for bit (Doppler columns 1.5143758e-3, 3.69e-5, 3.11e-4, 1.08e-3). 99.9 % of column 0 comes from one counted-Doppler row: a 1.66e-6 m/s jump when the end-b uplink transmit epoch t1 crosses an ulp(et) boundary; the F1/F2 station provider read SPICE at the quantised et0 + t (ulp 6e-8 s) without the exact-epoch correction (~17 um station step). The Doppler partial chain itself is correct (measurement-only differences fall as 1/h to <= 4.5e-6 at h = 1e-5).
root_cause.structural_gap: the historical G4e 'analytic' columns and its oracle share the same +/- propagations, so the gate never tested dx/dp. Against a converged reference (rtol 1e-12, h 1e-7) the F2g fd_history columns at rtol 1e-10, h 1e-9 were 14-76 % off (empirical) and 4.3 % off (K_SRP).

setup: identical to G4e: Problem(300, doppler=True, days=F2E_FIT_DAYS, n_emp=4), start/K from phase_f2d N200_-, empirical point [2e-9, -1e-9, 1.5e-9, -2e-9], 10 range + 10 Doppler rows (linspace), qualified numerics

gates.G0R: study propagation with empirical = 0 equals production propagate_state bit for bit at the qualified numerics
gates.G4eR_dyn: every one of the 11 dynamical columns of fd_history (6 state, K, 4 empirical): ||dr/dp - ref|| / ||ref|| over the whole grid <= 1e-2, ref = central differences at the same rtol with independent steps (state x10: 100 m / 0.1 m/s; K 5e-3; empirical 1e-7)
gates.G4eR_meas: range and Doppler partials of all 11 dynamical columns vs central differences of the full measurement function over the propagated +/- histories (the historical G4e oracle, now at the qualified steps): column relative error <= 1e-3 (the historical G4e threshold, unchanged)
gates.G4eR_jump: the historical jump row (Doppler row 5, column C_T): detrended Doppler over s in [-3e-9, 3e-9] m/s^2 (61 points) has no neighbour step above 1e-7 m/s (historical: 1.66e-6)

not_claimed: G4e-R qualifies partials only. It does not rerun the F2g/h/i fits, does not close G1/G2/G3, and says nothing about orbit accuracy.
